title: Iterate on an LLM, Serve on an SLM
abstract: arXiv:2610.14576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As frontier LLMs gain more capabilities, the cost to run them also goes up. At the same time, small language models (SLMs) also gain more capabilities but have largely been able to keep their cost stable, offering 5-40 times cheaper inference for the narrow, repetitive subtasks that agents decompose work into. However, the standing limiting factor is getting the correct behavior out of a small model in a fast, efficient, and economical way. Unfortunately, in most cases, zero-shot small models fail narrow production tasks. Furthermore, retraining one every time the behavior changes is too slow to iterate on. We propose doing both in sequence. First, develop the desired behavior in prompt space, on a frontier model, with immediate feedback from live traffic. Then, once the behavior converges, distill the recorded production behavior (not synthetic imitations of it) into an SLM through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We show a proper use case

translated_title: 在大模型上迭代，在小模型上部署
translated_abstract: 随着前沿大语言模型（LLM）的能力不断增强，其运行成本也在不断上升。与此同时，小语言模型（SLM）的能力也在提升，但其成本基本保持稳定，能够以低5-40倍的价格为智能体所分解出的狭窄、重复的子任务提供推理服务。然而，长期存在的限制因素是：如何以快速、高效且经济的方式让小模型表现出正确的行为。遗憾的是，在大多数情况下，零样本小模型无法胜任狭窄的生产任务。此外，每当行为需求发生变化时就重新训练一个小模型，迭代速度又太慢。我们提出将这两者按顺序结合：首先，在前沿模型的提示空间中开发期望的行为，并通过真实流量的即时反馈进行调整；然后，一旦行为收敛，就将记录下来的真实生产行为（而非其合成模仿版本）通过监督微调（SFT）蒸馏到一个SLM中。我们展示了一个恰当的使用案例。
tldr: 该论文提出“先在大模型上迭代、再在小模型上部署”的两阶段方法：先在前沿LLM上借助真实流量反馈快速迭代提示以确定正确行为，再将收敛后的真实生产行为通过监督微调蒸馏到小模型，从而以5-40倍更低的推理成本胜任狭窄重复的智能体子任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage approach—iterating on prompts with a frontier LLM using live-traffic feedback, then distilling the converged real production behavior into an SLM via SFT—to deliver 5-40x cheaper inference for narrow, repetitive agentic subtasks.
